=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text sp " "
text minus "-"
text tpush "push "
text tpop "pop "
text tempty "empty: "
text tyes "yes"
text tno "no"
text terr "pop from an empty queue: error"
global ring long 8
global head ulong 1
global cnt ulong 1
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note emitu writes n in decimal; 20 digits hold every ulong
fn emitu n ulong to void
d = new uchar 20 0
i = ulong 20
v = n
while true bound 20
i = sub i 1
put d i uchar add rem v 10 48
v = div v 10
if eq v 0
break
end
end
emit part d i sub 20 i
end
note emiti writes a signed n; the magnitude is taken as a ulong so the minimum long cannot overflow
fn emiti n long to void
if lt n 0
emit minus
emitu add bitcast ulong not n 1
else
emitu ulong n
end
end
note a FIFO queue in a ring of 8 slots: cnt elements starting at ring[head]; push writes behind the
note last one, pop takes ring[head]; a full ring stops the program (exit 2)
fn push v long to void
c = get cnt 0
if eq c 8
exit 2
end
put ring rem add get head 0 c 8 v
put cnt 0 add c 1
emit tpush
emiti v
emit nl
end
note pop returns false, and prints the error, when the queue is empty
fn pop to bool
c = get cnt 0
if eq c 0
emit terr
emit nl
ret false
end
h = get head 0
emit tpop
emiti get ring h
emit nl
put head 0 rem add h 1 8
put cnt 0 sub c 1
ret true
end
fn empty to void
emit tempty
if eq get cnt 0 0
emit tyes
else
emit tno
end
emit nl
end
note the ring wraps: 6 pushes, 4 pops and 5 more pushes cross slot 7 back to slot 0
fn main to int
empty
for i ulong 6
push mul long add i 1 11
end
for i ulong 4
ok = pop
end
for i ulong 5
push mul long add i 7 -11
end
empty
note 7 elements remain, so the 8th pop finds the queue empty and ends the loop
while pop bound 9
end
empty
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
